newsitem.title: CANADA: Moore Corp completes Peak tender offer.
newsitem.headline: Moore Corp completes Peak tender offer.

text.p: Moore Corp Ltd said on Wednesday it completed its tender offer to acquire the shares of The Peak Technologies Group Inc at C$18.00 per share.

Moore said 8,969,225 shares, representing 96.5 percent of all outstanding Peak shares were tendered to the offfer, and all such shares were accepted for payment by Moore's indirect wholly owned subsidiary, Kirkwood Acquisition Corp, following completion of the tender offer on May 27.
Any Peak shares not purchased in the tender offer will be acquired by Moore in a short-form merger, which is expected to be completed promptly, Moore said.
